title: imagebuildah: return true from waitForStage when stage fails with error
body:

#### What type of PR is this?

<!--
Please label this pull request according to what type of issue you are
addressing, especially if this is a release targeted pull request.

Uncomment only one `/kind <>` line, hit enter to put that in a new line, and
remove leading whitespace from that line:
-->

/kind bug


#### What this PR does / why we need it:
This fixes a bug that was mentioned in the below attached issue. In waitforstage(); it was returning false with the error when earlier stage finished with an error. All subsequent callers checked it, but they expect it to be true due to which this error was swallowed and moved forward. During parallel builds (--jobs=0 as shown in the issue), this lead to race condition where subsequent stage called s.Copy() on container that had already been torn down causing a sigsegv
#### How to verify it
1. Run parallel multi-stage failure tests:
    buildah build --jobs=0 --layers=false --
  platform=linux/amd64,linux/386 \
      -f tests/bud/multiarch/Dockerfile.fail-
  multistage tests/bud/multiarch

  2. Run the unit test suite:
    go test -v ./imagebuildah/...

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:
Fixes #6894
